2608.12218.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
2608.12218.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which hypothesizes that abundant relevant information in the training context can reduce the incentive to encode that information parametrically, thereby increasing reliance on context. In pretraining with long documents, increasing the context window improves language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book MCQA only up to an intermediate optimum, after which performance consistently declines. In supervised fine-tuning, more task-relevant train-time context improves performance with supporting context, but reduces robustness when context is absent or misleading at test time. Our analysis suggests that this behavior arises when longer context provides a lower complexity solution. Mechanistically, training with informative context shifts gradient pressure from feed-forward networks, often linked to parametric knowledge, toward attention modules, and causal interventions show that this shift increases reliance on context during inference. Overall, these findings support the Information Abundance Paradox and suggest that scaling toward near-infinite context is not simply a matter of supplying more data, even when high-quality long-context data is abundant.
2608.12218.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地在涵蓋文件、程式碼庫和互動歷史的長上下文中進行訓練和部署。這種擴展反映了隱含的假設，即在較長的上下文中訓練只會通過讓模型接觸到更豐富的證據來幫助模型。我們通過研究上下文窗口如何塑造模型的學習模式來挑戰這一觀點，將其在參數內化和情境化之間轉變。我們提出了信息豐富悖論，假設訓練上下文中的豐富相關信息可能會降低以參數方式編碼該信息的動機，從而增加對上下文的依賴。在使用長文件進行預訓練時，增加上下文窗口改善語言建模、自然語言理解和封閉書籍的多選題（MCQA），但僅到達一個中間最佳點，之後性能穩定下降。在監督微調中，更具任務相關性的訓練時上下文在有支持上下文的情況下提高了性能，但在測試時上下文缺失或誤導時降低了穩健性。我們的分析表明，當較長的上下文提供較低複雜度的解決方案時，會出現這種行為。在機制上，使用信息豐富的上下文進行訓練將梯度壓力從前饋網絡（通常與參數知識相關）轉移到注意力模塊，因果干預顯示這種轉變在推理過程中增加了對上下文的依賴。總體而言，這些發現支持信息豐富悖論，並表明向近乎無限上下文的擴展不僅僅是提供更多數據的問題，即使高質量的長上下文數據豐富。
